blocks.prompt: 15 An electric shop sells three types of appliances: Fans, Heaters, and Ovens. The monthly sales quantities are 500 units of Fans, 300 units of Heaters and 200 units of Ovens. The profit per unit for each appliance is Rs 500 for Fans, Rs 400 for Heaters, and Rs 2,000 for Ovens. (a) Represent the monthly sales quantities and the profit per unit as vectors.
blocks.explanation:
Is hisse mein sirf sawal ke alfaaz ko vectors ki zabaan mein likhna hai.
Diya kya hai? Teen cheezon (Fans, Heaters, Ovens) ki tadaad aur har ek ka munafa.
Find kya karna hai? Do vectors: ek tadaad ka, ek munafe ka.
Rule kaunsa? Har appliance ka ek component, aur dono vectors mein tarteeb bilkul ek jaisi.
Plan: Fans pehla component, Heaters doosra, Ovens teesra.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: tadaad 500, 300, 200; har unit ka munafa Rs 500, 400, 2000 (Fans, Heaters, Ovens).
Humein find karna hai: do vectors.
Tareeqa: Pehla component Fans ka, doosra Heaters ka, teesra Ovens ka. Kyun tarteeb itni ahem? Agle hisse mein dot product karna hai, jo pehle ko pehle se aur doosre ko doosre se multiply karta hai; tarteeb ghalat hui to Fans ki tadaad Ovens ke munafe se multiply ho jayegi.

Vectors likhein
\[\underline{q} = [500, 300, 200]\]
\[\underline{p} = [500, 400, 2000]\]
Kyun: \(\underline{q} = 500\underline{i} + 300\underline{j} + 200\underline{k}\) bechi gayi units hain, aur \(\underline{p} = 500\underline{i} + 400\underline{j} + 2000\underline{k}\) har unit par munafa (rupees). Bracket wali shakal \([a, b, c]\) aur \(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\) wali shakal ek hi cheez hain.

Tasdeeq
Fans: 500 bike, har ek par Rs 500; Heaters: 300, Rs 400; Ovens: 200, Rs 2000 \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Har component ko sawal ke data se mila kar dekha; sab sahi jagah par hain.
blocks.final_answer: Tadaad \(\underline{q} = [500, 300, 200]\), har unit ka munafa \(\underline{p} = [500, 400, 2000]\) (tarteeb: Fans, Heaters, Ovens)

blocks.prompt: 15 An electric shop sells three types of appliances: Fans, Heaters, and Ovens. The monthly sales quantities are 500 units of Fans, 300 units of Heaters and 200 units of Ovens. The profit per unit for each appliance is Rs 500 for Fans, Rs 400 for Heaters, and Rs 2,000 for Ovens. (b) Calculate the total monthly profit using vector operations.
blocks.explanation:
Kul munafa har cheez ke (tadaad \(\times\) fi unit munafa) ka jama hai, aur yahi dot product hai.
Diya kya hai? Part (a) ke dono vectors.
Find kya karna hai? Mahine ka kul munafa.
Rule kaunsa? \(\underline{q} \cdot \underline{p}\).
Plan: milte components multiply kar ke jama.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{q} = [500, 300, 200]\), \(\underline{p} = [500, 400, 2000]\).
Humein find karna hai: mahine ka kul munafa.
Tareeqa: kul munafa \(= \underline{q} \cdot \underline{p}\). Sawal ne "vector operations" kaha hai, aur yahan sahi operation dot product hai, kyunke jawab ek number (rupees) chahiye, vector nahi.

Dot product
\[\underline{q} \cdot \underline{p} = (500)(500) + (300)(400) + (200)(2000)\]
\[= 250{,}000 + 120{,}000 + 400{,}000\]
\[= 770{,}000\]
Kyun: Fans se \(500 \times 500 = 250{,}000\), Heaters se \(300 \times 400 = 120{,}000\), Ovens se \(200 \times 2000 = 400{,}000\) rupay munafa. Dot product teeno ko jama kar deta hai. Dilchasp baat: Ovens sab se kam bike lekin sab se zyada munafa unhi se aaya.

Tasdeeq
\[400{,}000 + 250{,}000 = 650{,}000\]
\[650{,}000 + 120{,}000 = 770{,}000 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Doosri tarteeb se jama kiya, wohi jawab. Answer key bhi Rs 770000 deti hai.
